title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.30105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. translated_title: 非对称在策略蒸馏学习情境化探索
translated_abstract: 在部分可观测条件下的序贯决策十分困难，因为智能体必须先通过探索来推断隐藏的、与任务相关的信息，然后才能有效地行动。通过在线强化学习从零开始学习这种信息收集行为的样本效率很低，而离线模仿学习则会在不同的隐藏状态之间平均专家动作，从而无法学到探索行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了 ASTEROID，这是一个简单而有效的学生-教师监督学习框架，能够学习测试时的探索行为。尽管拥有特权信息的教师从不需要探索，我们证明了基于历史条件的学生模型在与策略上下文一起训练时能够学会探索：学生首先在部分可观测条件下收集在策略上下文，特权教师则基于该上下文提供动作标签。通过直接在学生的在策略历史条件下蒸馏专家动作，学生能够学会系统地收集与任务相关的信息。
tldr: 提出ASTEROID学生-教师蒸馏框架，让拥有特权信息的教师基于学生在部分可观测环境中自主收集的在策略历史上下文提供动作标签，从而使学生学会测试时的情境化探索行为。
en_tdlr: ASTEROID distills a privileged expert's actions conditioned on the student's own on-policy history, enabling a history-conditioned student to learn in-context exploration under partial observability.
